d: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.
Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.
En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

Åtte måneder etter at en ukjent morder kappet hodet av en turist, ankommer den unge Jennifer Corvino til Sveits for å begynne på sin nye privatskole. Når Jennifer går i søvne blir hun vitne til et nytt drap og går seg vill i skogen.

t: Stephen King's Sometimes They Come Back
d: A high school teacher (Tim Matheson) faces the demon ghosts of a gang of former students. Brooke Adams, Robert Hy Gorman, Robert Rusler, Nicholas Sadler, and William Sanderson also star. Based on a short story by Stephen King.

Alan embarks on a 100-mile hitchhike to see his mother in the hospital. Along the way, he must confront his many demons both living and dead, and in the end, make the ultimate choice that will mean life or death for him and his mother! (2005)

Rated R

When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money.  The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.
Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her.  As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.
Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him.  Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.
